options.content: **StudySlot A3: load balancing across replicas A, B, C.** HTTP on the left, gRPC on the right. Test operations: HTTP `GET /bookings/{id}` and gRPC `CreateBooking` (idempotent replay). Prometheus scrapes each replica directly (`studyslot-app-1/2/3`, label `replica`) and Envoy's admin port, never through Envoy. Rates and percentiles use a **1-minute window** (`[1m]`). The *share over the selected time range* panels use `$__range`: set the time picker to a run's start and end (printed by `scripts/load_test.py`) to read that run's A/B/C split. This dashboard shows times in **UTC**, like the results files.

panels.description: In-flight gauge (http_requests_in_flight{method="GET", route="/bookings/{booking_id}"}). Solid: average over 1m (smooths the 5 s samples). Dotted: the raw sample at each scrape. Dashed grey: Envoy's active requests to this cluster (all replicas together).

panels.description: histogram_quantile over http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{method="GET", route="/bookings/{booking_id}"}, per replica, rate window 1m. Measured inside the replica, so it excludes Envoy and the network (the client's p95 is in the load_test output).

panels.description: Non-success results counted by each replica (http_requests_total{method="GET", route="/bookings/{booking_id}", status!~"2.."}), plus requests Envoy itself failed because no replica answered (upstream 5xx on cluster studyslot_http, e.g. a stopped replica). For gRPC, Envoy still answers HTTP 200 and puts the error in grpc-status (UNAVAILABLE), but its cluster counts the failed upstream request as 503. 1m window.
